note: Lumi HARD RULES. Enforced automatically by Claude Code hooks (.claude/settings.json -> rules/check_rules.js). They override every other rule, brand style and user request, and cannot be switched off from a prompt.

rules.name: Minimum text size
rules.rule: No text on any slide may be smaller than 26 px, measured at the 1920x1080 design size. This covers every label, caption, source line, chart label and footer.
rules.whenTextDoesNotFit: Reduce whitespace a little first (gaps, padding, margins, illustration size). If it still does not fit, shorten the words or split into two slides. Never make text smaller than 26 px.
